title: Codex transcript lookup must resolve the Codex home the way Codex does (CODEX_HOME, empty counts as unset)
answers: Codex traces missing model, tool calls, or token usage when CODEX_HOME is set
Codex session transcript not found for custom CODEX_HOME launcher
Why does Codex enrichment fall back to notify payload only
Empty CODEX_HOME breaks Codex transcript discovery
body:
Symptom: Codex traces from a launcher that sets a custom CODEX_HOME show no model, tool calls/results, span timing or token usage; only the notify payload is recorded.
Root cause: libs/typescript/integrations/codex/src/transcript.ts:findTranscriptForThread previously hard-coded join(homedir(), '.codex', 'sessions'), ignoring where Codex actually writes rollouts.
Fix pattern: derive the base as `process.env.CODEX_HOME || join(homedir(), '.codex')` and search `join(codexHome, 'sessions')`. Keep the lookup in this one function so every enrichment path uses the same directory.
Constraints: use `||`, not `??`; Codex treats an empty CODEX_HOME as unset, and launchers often forward an optional variable as ''. Empty must fall back to ~/.codex. Transcript lookup is optional enrichment, so a missing directory must still return null, not throw.
applies: Any change to how the Codex integration locates rollout files or other Codex state on disk.
says: Codex traces are missing tool calls, model names, and token usage details.
Custom launcher sessions only show notify payloads instead of full execution traces.
Codex session transcripts are not discovered when using a custom directory path.
An empty home directory configuration breaks transcript lookup for Codex traces.
Show complete span timing and tool results for all recorded Codex sessions.
search: Codex transcript lookup in libs/typescript/integrations/codex/src/transcript.ts:findTranscriptForThread must resolve rollout sessions under process.env.CODEX_HOME || join(homedir(), '.codex') to prevent missing model, tool call, timing, and token trace data. This applies to any change in the Codex integration locating disk rollout files or session state. Logical OR (||) must be used instead of nullish coalescing (??) so empty strings fall back to ~/.codex, and missing directories must return null rather than throwing.
